requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so the energy class must be C, B, or any A class. Area, capacity, location, and public transport criteria are not energy-related and are outside this agent's scope.
User wants the building located near public transport. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).
The project is a university student residence, so proximity to universities and schools is clearly necessary. Threshold is the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75).

The user explicitly requires a minimum gross floor area of 850 sqm. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area filter, since no verified gross-area threshold was supplied. The student-residence conversion describes future use and was not used to filter the current typology.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili' (the filterable equivalent of tipologia_bene_immobile), surface_area >= 850, a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892, energy_class in A1–A4/B/C, mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinate. The 60-person capacity and the CDP/PNRR program were not in the extracted requirements, so they add no predicates.
